:::{#def-mutual-information}
#### Mutual information

The **mutual information** between
[discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$ and $Y$
with finite entropies
is the sum <!-- check-term-links: allow --> of their [entropies](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy)
minus their [joint entropy](#def-joint-entropy):

$$I(X; Y) \eqdef \entropyf{X} + \entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{X, Y}.$$

:::
